title: 怎么约美国孩子一起玩？playdate 英语
summary: 美国家长常约 playdate 让孩子们一起玩。这篇教你怎么开口约、聊时间地点，以及拼车的话术。

featuredPhrase.en: Can our kids have a playdate?

phrases.en: Can our kids have a playdate?
Do you want to join our carpool?
phrases.zh: 你要加入我们的拼车吗？

phrases.en: What time should I pick him up?

dialogue.speaker: Parent A
dialogue.en: Hi! Our kids get along so well. Can they have a playdate?
dialogue.zh: 你好！我们孩子玩得很好。他们能约着玩吗？

dialogue.speaker: Parent B
dialogue.en: That would be great! Are you free this Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Parent A
dialogue.en: Yes! What time should I drop him off?
dialogue.zh: 有空！我几点把他送过去？

dialogue.speaker: Parent B
dialogue.en: How about 10 am? You can pick him up at 1.
dialogue.zh: 上午 10 点怎么样？1 点来接他。

dialogue.speaker: Parent A
dialogue.en: Perfect. By the way, do you want to join our carpool to school?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。顺便问下，你要加入我们上学的拼车吗？

dialogue.speaker: Parent B
dialogue.en: Yes, please! That would save us so much time.
dialogue.zh: 好啊！那能省我们好多时间。

seoDescription: 怎么用英语约美国孩子 playdate？本文教你开口约时间、拼车的话术，附完整对话。
